title: A prompt generator that takes the opposite route
summary:
A community app made image prompts do the opposite, while Enter gained a tier checkout entry point and clearer generation authentication.

Ankit Anand added the Opposite Prompt Generator, and its Hacktoberfest showcase entry was merged. The React app turns an image prompt into a short semantic opposite, generates an image from it, and lets users copy the prompt or image URL, download the image, and retry a failed load.

Enter added a panel showing a signed-in user's assigned tier and a checkout button for Seed, Flower, or Nectar. The change starts a Polar checkout; it does not establish that completing checkout activates a tier. A follow-up removed the inaccurate refill countdown and disabled the $10, $25, and $50 Pollen top-up buttons.

Enter's generation routes now accept either a session cookie or an API key in an `Authorization: Bearer` header, while tier and Polar routes remain session-only. The work also tightened anonymous-access rules, adjusted chat request validation, and removed the `/openai/chat/completions` alias in favor of `/api/generate/openai`.

highlights.title: Opposite Prompt Generator
highlights.text: Turn an image prompt into its semantic opposite, then generate an image from the result. Copy the new prompt or image URL, or download the image.
